launcher.description: Fictional shoulder-fired launcher: olive-drab tube, worn paint, pistol and front grips, optical sight on the left.

rocket.description: Fictional finned rocket: olive warhead with a pale yellow band, gunmetal motor, three fins.

gun.description: Fictional light machine gun: olive-drab receiver, ventilated shroud and stock, ported muzzle brake, box magazine, rail with a rear aperture sight.
